### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of roasted meats, a fresh rice-paper roll, and a whole apple. The central piece appears to be bone-in poultry; the darker meat at upper right looks like roast pork with skin.

### 2 — Vessel
A dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Heights below are average heights across each item’s footprint. No separate oil or sauce is clearly visible.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area, cm² | Height, cm | Gross volume, ml | Density, g/ml | Weight, g | kcal/100 g | Energy, kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Whole apple | 8% | 42.5 | 4.4 | 187 | 0.85 | 159 | 52 | 83 |
| Fresh rice-paper roll with vegetables, possibly shrimp | 7% | 37.2 | 1.7 | 63 | 0.90 | 57 | 110 | 63 |
| Bone-in roasted poultry portion, centre | 20% | 106.2 | 1.5 | 159 | 0.95 | 151 | 170* | 257 |
| Roast pork with skin, upper right | 12% | 63.7 | 1.8 | 115 | 0.95 | 109 | 330 | 360 |
| Skin-on roasted chicken piece, left | 6.5% | 34.5 | 1.4 | 48 | 0.95 | 46 | 250 | 115 |
| Small strip of white chicken meat, bottom | 4% | 21.2 | 0.6 | 13 | 0.95 | 12 | 165 | 20 |

**Coverage check:** 8 + 7 + 20 + 12 + 6.5 + 4 = **57.5%** of the plate, consistent with the visible empty rim and gaps.

\*The central portion’s weight includes its bone; its energy density is reduced accordingly, rather than treating the entire weight as edible meat.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **534 g as plated and approximately 900 kcal**. That is plausible for a large apple, several meat portions, and a small fresh roll. The largest uncertainty is the identity and fat content of the upper-right meat.
